easyPrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is 11 or greater.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating a Food, Clue and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two artifact tokens, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.
